messages.author: f737c5dac40bd4dc
messages.subject: Error Installing Rhipe on a Hadoop cluster gateway machine - got error on protobuf headers
parts:
Installing Rhipe on a Hadoop cluster gateway machine. R already
installed in user directory. No root privileges. Installing Rhipe and
protobuf in user's directory as well. Got error on "R CMD INSTALL
Rhipe_0.66.tar.gz" on protobuf headers. Any suggestion/previous
experience?

1)
cd ~/dev
wget http://protobuf.googlecode.com/files/protobuf-2.4.1.tar.gz
tar -xzvf protobuf-2.4.1.tar.gz
cd protobuf-2.4.1
./configure
make
export PKG_CONFIG_PATH=/homes/max/dev/protobuf-2.4.1wget

2)
cd ~/dev
wget http://ml.stat.purdue.edu/rhipe/download/Rhipe_0.66.tar.gz
tar -xzvf Rhipe_0.66.tar.gz
cd Rhipe
alias R='/homes/max/dev/R-2.13.1/bin/R'
export R_HOME=/homes/max/dev/R-2.13.1
./configure

3)
cd ~/dev
R CMD INSTALL Rhipe_0.66.tar.gz

But the problems persists when I am installing Rhipe in non-standard
location (standard location is not an option at this time for shared
resource ) "CMD INSTALL Rhipe_0.66.tar.gz" - "R was not built as a
library".

I rebuilt R enabling shared library
./configure --prefix=$CUSTROOT --enable-R-shlib
make
make prefix=$CUSTROOT install

But Rhipe installation still fails with errors shown below.
$CUSTROOT points to the non standard location /homes/max/usr/local

Any help with that would be appreciated

Thanks
Konstantin
